cache_policy: enabled; cache key includes normalized text, model, revision, voice, speed, steps, sample rate
known_limitations: Do not send raw Latin text directly to OmniVoice Thai.
Arabic digits should be normalized to Thai spoken form.
Some loanwords can still cause a foreign accent.
Some pronunciations may require a game-specific dictionary after human approval.
Voice personality control is limited to runtime-supported tags.
Narrator speed remains pending final human selection.
